clips.title: The story
paras: "Your Package Has Arrived" is an urgent courier task concerning misplaced mail intended for delivery in Ironforge. A courier crate sent all the way from the Wildhammer stronghold of Aerie Peak was left abandoned beside a mailbox, addressed specifically to Eldrun Stormbreaker. Travelers who discover the parcel are tasked with completing its journey and seeing that it reaches its rightful owner.

A postal mishap leaves several stray parcels abandoned beside a city mailbox, left out in the open rather than carried safely to their destinations. Among this jumbled heap of neglected freight sits an urgent parcel marked for delivery all the way from Aerie Peak, the mountain redoubt of the Wildhammer dwarves in the Hinterlands. Transporting goods between distant outposts across Khaz Modan and Lordaeron can be perilous and chaotic, meaning mislaid parcels occasionally require an alert passerby to step in and finish the delivery route properly.

The misplaced package bears clear labeling designating Ironforge as its destination and Eldrun Stormbreaker as its final recipient. Marked explicitly with an urgent notice, whatever cargo the bundle holds was deemed important enough to be expedited from the rustic peaks of the Hinterlands to the subterranean halls of the dwarven capital. Taking up the crate means taking on the responsibility of the postal service, ensuring that Eldrun receives what was sent across mountain ridges and wild hills before it can be stolen or forgotten completely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent."

clips.title: Completion
paras: What! I've been going to the mailbox by the bank every day looking for this package! This city needs to figure out its layout. Not easy to navigate like Aerie Peak!
Let's see what I've got... Totem carving tools... Spare axe... Some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back.
Er, uh... I mean... Thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.
